data.gender_notes: Brindha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brindha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Brind' meaning lotus. In Hindu mythology, Brindha is the name of a celestial nymph, who is believed to have emerged from the lotus flower. She is also known as Brinda or Brindavani, and is associated with Lord Krishna and the Radha-Krishna relationship. The name Brindha carries the meaning “Lotus born” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Brindha usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus born and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine feminine energy and the purity and beauty of the lotus flower.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brindha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
